violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was (25) parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. PIC shall use 3-bay sink to sanitize until dishwasher is serviced/reaching proper sanitizing levels (50-100 ppms). New Violation. Correct By: 05/15/2025

Wood is used in the construction of blocks behind the faucet handles of the hand wash sinks in the women's restroom. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2024
The walls above/behind the food prep and ware-washing areas did not consist of approved material. Per interview wit PIC, FRP board to be placed in these areas. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2024
